A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have proposed a novel face recognition system, FaceNet, that is able to achieve state-of-the-art recognition results on LFW, YTF and IJB-A benchmarks while running in real-time on a single machine.

we have proposed a new deep convolutional network architecture for learning face representations and demonstrated its effectiveness for a variety of face recognition, verification, and clustering tasks.

a well designed end-to-end deep architecture can achieve state-of-the-art recognition accuracy on large-scale benchmarks without the need for sophisticated hand-crafted features.
a good embedding space for face verification can be learned in a supervised manner directly from images without requiring extensive engineering.
